2026_025_february_2026_p_card_report.paragraph: The February 2026 P-Card Report for Troy School District is a line-by-line listing of every purchasing-card transaction posted for the month, each entry carrying a transaction date, an abbreviated merchant name, the journal-entry description FEB 2026 PCAR EXP, a business-unit and account string, and a dollar amount. The listing runs 35 pages, each footed with the print date 4/9/2026, and was carried on the Board of Education agenda for the April 21, 2026 meeting. A single grand total of $260,990.75 is printed at the end. The largest individual postings are three Grand Traverse Resort charges dated 2/16/2026 of $7,371.09, $7,371.09 and $6,302.62.
